mapper.select: SELECT s.id,s.execution_id,s.assignment_id,s.segment_no,s.started_at,s.ended_at,s.end_reason, s.eligible_until,s.time_zone,s.heartbeat_timeout_seconds,s.created_at,s.updated_at FROM execution_segment s JOIN execution_session e ON e.id=s.execution_id AND e.user_id=#{userId} WHERE s.execution_id=#{executionId} AND s.ended_at IS NULL
